Shoppers

Generated by TestReport in pkg/internal/mock/shopper: each persona taken through the shop. The persona picks; the shop ranks every listing by the vector the shopper's events add up to so far. Visits are relative to BaseTime, {{date .BaseTime}}.

JourneysMonthsFinal ranking

Journeys

The converting journey of each persona, with the list id of every listing and of every selection made from one: the department, the trousers, the dresses, and back to the department narrowed to the persona's occasion; a view and add to cart of what it opened there; a closing look at the department; then home decoration — the department, ranked only by what carries over from fashion through shared dimensions, and the category of the pick there — and last a look at all products, with nothing opened. On every other listing the persona opens something it likes from the first few positions: not always the first, not always its favourite.

Months

Each persona's shopper.Month: seven visits over four weeks, mostly browsing, buying twice. Every visit ends on the same product because the persona is steady; the distillery report shows what happens when it is not. The line under each visit is the shop learning: how many interactions the landing page was ranked by — none on the first visit — and where the product the shopper ends on ranked there, overall and on its own rail. Where it is not first overall, the thumbnail beside it is what the shop put first instead.

Final ranking

Every visit ends on the top-level listing of all products, ranked by everything the shop has learned — its whole view of the shopper, across both departments. Shown after a single converting journey and after the last visit of a month. Under each product: its place and its score under the learned profile. Outlined: the persona's favourite in each category — read per category, each should come first among its category's products wherever the shopper chose.
